patch.summary: ScraperAPI cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: ScraperAPI pricing is plan-gated across 5 researched tiers. Free entry: Free. 7-day trial documented. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.

blocks.title: ScraperAPI plan matrix and who each tier suits
blocks.body: Structure and trial/free flags come from SoftwareGlimpse pricing research. Dollar amounts appear only when verified — never invent list prices.

blocks.heading: ScraperAPI cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price ScraperAPI against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Stay on Free until a gated capability (premium unlock) becomes mandatory.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (CI/CD and automation, proxy / web data network) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Domain credit multipliers (Amazon/Google/LinkedIn/bot-bypass) change effective cost vs sticker floors. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

steps.label: Pay up when Developers who want a managed scrape API without operating proxy pools requires a paid unlock you will use weekly
Do not overbuy if this limitation dominates: Domain credit multipliers (Amazon/Google/LinkedIn/bot-bypass) change effective cost vs sticker floors
Side-by-side cost with Bright Data on the same seat count

items.title: Cost trap 1
items.body: Domain credit multipliers (Amazon/Google/LinkedIn/bot-bypass) change effective cost vs sticker floors

items.title: Cost trap 2
items.body: Unused credits do not roll over

items.title: Cost trap 3
items.body: Not a raw residential proxy network like Bright Data / Oxylabs

items.title: Cost trap 4
items.body: Not ITSM, observability, git, or hosting panel

items.title: Cost trap 5
items.body: Geotargeting is limited on Hobby/Startup (US & EU)

blocks.title: Cheaper or clearer alternatives to pressure-test
blocks.body: Compare total cost of ownership vs ScraperAPI on identical constraints.
